perplexity.description:
These Systems Are Failing is the thirteenth studio album by American musician Moby, released on October 14, 2016, under the moniker Moby & The Void Pacific Choir via Little Idiot and Mute Records. The album marks a notable departure from Moby’s earlier electronic sound, embracing a raw, guitar-driven style that blends elements of punk rock, post-punk, and electronic music. With a runtime of just over 35 minutes, the record features short, urgent tracks characterized by distorted vocals, aggressive rhythms, and a sense of political and emotional urgency, reflecting Moby’s response to contemporary social and political turmoil.

This album stands as the debut release for Moby & The Void Pacific Choir, a collaborative project featuring Moby alongside vocalists Mindy Jones, Julie Mintz, Joel Nesvadba, Jamie Drake, Jonathan Nesvadba, and Lauren Tyler Scott. Musically, it diverges from the ambient and dance-oriented works that defined much of Moby’s earlier career, instead channeling a more confrontational and anthemic approach. Critics noted the album’s impassioned delivery and its willingness to experiment with genre, though reception was mixed, with some praising its energy and others finding it uneven. Commercially, the album did not achieve major chart success but remains a distinctive entry in Moby’s diverse discography.
